title: Message Queue Demo
description: Demonstrates four core Artemis JMS scenarios: point-to-point, pub-sub, delayed message, and tag filtering

queue.title: Point-to-Point Queue
queue.description: A message is consumed by only one consumer (the classic MQ scenario)

topic.title: Publish/Subscribe
topic.description: A message is broadcast to all subscribers (A/B subscribers on the same node both receive it)

delay.title: Delayed Message
delay.description: Consumer receives the message N seconds after sending (e.g. order timeout close)

tag.title: Tag Filtering
tag.description: Producer sends by tag, consumer subscribes only specific tags via selector

records.title: Consumption Records
records.description: Records processed by consumers, auto-refreshed every 2 seconds. Cleared on service restart.
records.empty: No records yet, send a message above to start

messages.clearConfirm: Are you sure to clear all consumption records?
